note: One H19 method; suffixes are experiment identifiers, not separate methods.

experiments.hypothesis: Six semantic axes contain above-random signal in Jev outputs.
reusable_lessons: Do not trust one axis absolute score without ablation.

experiments.hypothesis: D5 signal is robust to lexical/context perturbation.
experiments.result: Lexical/context cue causally moves D5; D1 co-moves.
anti_patterns: Treating lock-related text as direct proof of D5.

experiments.result: Control set did not reproduce the intended H19a failure mode.
reusable_lessons: A strong treatment result is not interpretable if the control task is too easy.

experiments.hypothesis: Facts add value beyond Choice framing on adversarial D5 cases.
experiments.result: Facts acted as a prior and hurt; V remained best.
reusable_lessons: Keep extractable facts in code by default.

experiments.hypothesis: Relative-axis score S0 = D5 - max(other) beats raw D5 and works as router.
experiments.result: Relative-axis router did not replicate; co-occurring true axes penalized real D5.
reusable_lessons: Multi-axis true positives must be represented prospectively.
anti_patterns: Assuming D5 must be the dominant axis.

experiments.hypothesis: Pre-calibrated raw D5 threshold 0.64 preserves recall and reduces System Two load.
experiments.result: Recall held, but D1/D5 conflation prevented enough load reduction.
reusable_lessons: Raw D5 is a strong ranker.
D1 and D5 are a persistent semantic neighborhood.
anti_patterns: Threshold tuning as a fix for D1/D5 overlap.

experiments.hypothesis: A second cheap Choice can resolve D1-only vs D5-involved without receiving V scores as premises.
reusable_lessons: Second-stage resolver must see the diff, not first-stage score facts.
Binary D5-involved routing can succeed even when exact D1_ONLY/D5_ONLY/BOTH/OTHER classification is imperfect.
Synthetic balanced-set call savings are not production cost evidence.
experiments.result: Composite router passed all preregistered gates. Resolver works for binary D5-involved routing; full four-class semantics are weaker.

experiments.hypothesis: Validated composite router reduces real System Two work in shadow PR traffic while preserving actionable D5 recall.

invariant_rules: Use fresh cases after method changes.
Do not relabel disagreements; drop them.
Ban repeated mutations across validation sets.
Reject sets carried by a naive feature AUC > 0.70.
Balance hard negatives and multi-axis positives.
Keep extractable facts out of model premises by default.
Evaluate operational cost/load separately from AUC.
